instruction: Open the reminder document on the Desktop and export it as a PDF file in the same location.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting a small document (reminder.docx) to PDF. Evaluator checks if reminder.pdf exists on Desktop with minimum size of 1KB. This is a simpler PDF export task than variation 0.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: PDF file exists at the specified path (/home/user/Desktop/reminder.pdf)
Getter logic is correct: uses bash command to check file existence and extract size
Metric logic is correct: validates existence and minimum size requirement (1KB)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file state, metric compares against expected rules
No postconfig needed: PDF file persists after creation
Edge cases handled: getter handles missing files and parsing errors gracefully
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing min_size_kb threshold based on actual reminder.docx file size to better validate successful export

Content verification limitation: evaluator only checks existence and size, not that the PDF actually contains the correct content from reminder.docx (though this is acceptable for most practical purposes given the specific filename)
